description: This file defines a class `Sort` that handles parsing of order-by clauses for sorting in JSON API repository functionality. It includes constants for sort directions and a method to parse and validate sort fields against a SugarBean instance.

classes.name: Sort
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing and validating the 'order by' sorting parameter in JSON API repository operations.

methods.name: parseOrderBy
methods.description: Parses the order-by string, determines sort direction (ascending or descending), validates the field against the bean's field definitions, and returns a formatted string for sorting.
